desktop.notes:
• Sets from a folder works every time (a second run made no sets) and can replace the previous result.
• Choose how many sets to make: Auto, fewer (an even spread) or more (new combinations, no repeats in a set).
• Collages slider: how many screens become collages; optional random collage layouts.
• In-app updates: a button appears when a new version is ready; only changed files are downloaded.
